Card Q&A.a: The processing shown after "instead" in the effect replaces the standard processing. For example, if an effect reads "Delete your opponent's Digimon with 6000 DP or less. If you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, instead delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP," and you have a Digimon with [Greymon] in its name, you delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with the lowest DP instead of deleting 1 of their Digimon with 6000 DP or less.
Card Q&A.q: What does an "instead" effect mean, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can process it. Even if your opponent doesn't have 10 or fewer cards in their hand, this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect will delete 1 of their level 3 or lower Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: Can I process the part of the effect after "then" in this card's [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] effect even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Effect: [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] If your opponent has 10 or fewer cards in their trash, trash the top 3 cards of both players' decks. Then, delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 or lower Digimon. If your opponent has 10 or more cards in their trash, add 2 to this effect's level maximum.
Inherited Effect: [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] This Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. If your opponent has 10 or fewer cards in their trash, instead trash the top 2 cards of both players' decks.
